semiconductor_relevance: High — Taihe Gases specializes in the production of electronic specialty gases critical for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Taihe Gases (Jingzhou) Corporation Limited is a leading provider of electronic specialty gases, focusing on R&D and production for high-tech industries including semiconductors. The company offers high-purity gases such as chlorine and hydrogen chloride, which are essential for various semiconductor processes.
capabilities: Germanium tetrafluoride and boron trifluoride production

regional_presence.China: Taihe Gases is based in Jingzhou, China, and has established long-term relationships with domestic and international semiconductor users.
